companions.name: Wisp
companions.description: A pale flame that drifts behind you and spits sparks at the nearest foe.

companions.name: Bone Sparrow
companions.description: A little bird of knuckle bones. It pecks from afar.

companions.name: Drone Mite
companions.description: A buzzing mite of wire and wax that fires quick, weak shots.

companions.name: Cinder Kit
companions.description: A fox kit made of coals. Its shots sometimes set foes alight.

companions.name: Frost Moth
companions.description: Its wingbeats leave rime on whatever it hits.

companions.name: Blight Toad
companions.description: Spits green bile that festers.

companions.name: Lantern Eye
companions.description: A floating eye that watches the far side of the room.

companions.name: Static Wren
companions.description: Crackles as it flies. Hits may stun.

companions.name: Echo Shade
companions.description: A shadow that copies every shot you take, a little weaker.

companions.name: Twin Husk
companions.description: A hollow double of you. It fires when you fire.

companions.name: Mirror Shard
companions.description: A floating sliver of glass that throws back your shots.

companions.name: Dread Puppet
companions.description: A stitched doll that mimics your aim. Its shots unsettle.

companions.name: Ash Halo
companions.description: A ring of ash circling you. It burns what it touches and eats shots.

companions.name: Grave Stone
companions.description: A heavy stone on a slow orbit. Shots break against it.

companions.name: Thorn Ring
companions.description: Fast-spinning thorns that shred enemies close to you.

companions.name: Ember Moon
companions.description: A wide orbit of slow fire.

companions.name: Cold Shield
companions.description: A disc of ice that spins close and soaks up shots.

companions.name: Gnaw Rat
companions.description: A starving rat that runs down the nearest enemy.

companions.name: Bramble Hound
companions.description: A dog of thorny vines. Slow, but it bites hard.

companions.name: Spite Imp
companions.description: A tiny imp that throws itself at foes.

companions.name: Rot Leech
companions.description: Clings to enemies and drinks.

companions.name: Magpie
companions.description: Grabs loose pickups and brings them to you.

companions.name: Sack Goblin
companions.description: A grubby goblin that hoards dropped things for you.

companions.name: Fuse Beetle
companions.description: Lays little bombs near enemies. They never hurt you.

companions.name: Powder Crow
companions.description: Drops a big charge every so often.

companions.name: Coin Mole
companions.description: Digs up a coin every couple of cleared rooms.

companions.name: Key Wisp
companions.description: Finds a key every few cleared rooms.

companions.name: Heart Moth
companions.description: Leaves a half heart behind every few cleared rooms.

companions.name: Powder Sprite
companions.description: Leaves a bomb behind every few cleared rooms.

companions.name: Ward Knight
companions.description: A tiny knight that steps in front of incoming shots.
